props.name: autofocus
props.description:
Focus the button on mount. Kept for API parity with Nuxt UI v4 — the
Vue-Lynx core button renders a non-focusable `<view>`, so this is
currently a no-op.

props.name: avatar
props.description: When set, render `<VyAvatar>` in the leading slot instead of an icon.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Iconify shorthand. Routed to the trailing side when `trailing` is true,
otherwise to the leading side. Explicit `leadingIcon` / `trailingIcon`
always win.

props.name: label
props.description: Text label. Overridden by the default slot if provided.

props.name: leading
props.description: Force `icon` shorthand onto the leading side.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the leading side (wins over `icon`).

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Iconify name for the spinner. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.loading`.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Force `icon` shorthand onto the trailing side.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the trailing side (wins over `icon`).

props.name: type
props.description:
HTML button type. Kept for API parity with Nuxt UI v4 — the Vue-Lynx
core button renders a `<view>`, so this is currently a no-op forward.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the variant's resolved foreground.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the variant's resolved foreground.
